quotes.author: Nick
quotes.text: Nick2 months agoWe had a wonderful time on the paddle boat and thoroughly enjoyed the trip. The boat was well-appointed, and the crew was knowledgeable, friendly, and very attentive throughout our excursion.Having a restroom on board was an added convenience on the stern. Although the day was clear and quite hot, we remained comfortable thanks to the large awning that shaded the main seating area. There was also a small area at the bow of the boat where you could enjoy the full sun if you preferred.Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable experience, and we would highly recommend it.

quotes.author: Dameon Shaw
quotes.text: Dameon Shaw3 months agoI had an awesome time on my tiki cruise with Sea Suite Cruises! The whole vibe was super chill — great music, friendly crew, and the perfect setup for kicking back on the water. The boat was clean, comfy, and had that fun tropical feel that makes you instantly relax.The staff really made the experience feel easy and enjoyable, and the views were unbeatable. Whether you’re hanging with friends or just want a fun break on the water, this cruise is definitely worth it. I’d 100% go again!

quotes.author: Kristen Williams
quotes.text: Kristen Williams3 months agoI cannot say enough amazing things about my experience on this cruise. The booking process was extremely easy. I kept in touch with a representative to easily make updates to my reservation. The staff on board were fabulous!!!! I recommend this to anyone that wants to celebrate with a large group and I will absolutely be booking this experience again in the future!

quotes.author: Julie Rush
quotes.text: Julie Rush3 months agoWhat a fantastic way to spend 90 minutes! We had a group of 10 and took one of the smaller boats captained by Jack and Josh. We left from the Navy Yard and cruised to the Wharf. It was a gorgeous day and we had a ball. Jack and Josh were awesome. I live in DC and I will absolutely do this again and I will be requesting Jack and Josh.

quotes.author: austin hampton
quotes.text: austin hampton3 months agoWe had an incredible time celebrating my friend for his bachelor party. Captain Matt and Emma have an incredible vibe. Capt. Matt is a true DMV native and is a wealth of knowledge of the landmarks along the waterfront and beyond. Emma keeps the everyone safe and the party going. Book with them if you can!

quotes.author: Kate Francis
quotes.text: Kate Francis3 months agoOur group 14 had such a good time on the boat with Malcolm and Captain Luke! It was the perfect way to spend a Saturday afternoon. Our cruise was BYOB and snacks, so we got to enjoy ourselves while seeing DC from the water, which was a first for us. Would highly recommend, and hope to do it again next year.
